chapters.headline: Scroll to Begin
chapters.title: Stanley Peninsula
chapters.description: The Stanley Peninsula is a picturesque coastal area on the southeastern tip of Hong Kong Island, known for its scenic waterfront, beaches, and historic landmarks. It combines natural beauty with vibrant local culture, making it one of Hong Kong's most popular seaside destinations.

chapters.headline: Sheer Scale and Heritage
chapters.title: Hong Kong's Largest Secondary School Campus
chapters.description: Spanning more than 40 acres, St. Stephen's College blends nearly a century of heritage architecture with contemporary educational facilities, creating one of Hong Kong's most distinctive learning environments.

chapters.headline: A Timeless Arrival
chapters.title: Main Entrance
chapters.description: The ceremonial gateway introduces visitors to nearly a century of architectural heritage and the enduring identity of St. Stephen's College.

chapters.headline: Hong Kong's Oldest Boarding School Landmark
chapters.title: School House
chapters.description: Completed in 1929 and now a Declared Monument, the School House combines Western classical architecture with traditional Chinese roofing, standing as the iconic heart of the College.

chapters.headline: A Century of Boarding Tradition
chapters.title: Martin Hostel
chapters.description: Built in 1929, this Grade II historic building has welcomed generations of boarders while preserving its original timber floors, granite columns, and timeless architectural character.

chapters.headline: A Place of Reflection
chapters.title: St. Stephen's Chapel
chapters.description: Standing at the highest point of campus since 1950, the Chapel serves as a memorial to those affected by World War II and remains a place of worship and remembrance.

chapters.headline: Post-War Expansion
chapters.title: Classroom Block
chapters.description: Constructed in 1964, the Grade III Classroom Block reflects the College's post-war growth and continues to support everyday teaching and learning.

chapters.headline: Knowledge and Discovery
chapters.title: Library
chapters.description: The College Library continues a long tradition of scholarship, providing a quiet centre for learning within the historic campus.

chapters.headline: Designed for Innovation
chapters.title: Special Room Block
chapters.description: Designed by renowned architect Dr. Tao Ho, the award-winning Special Room Block has been home to the College's science laboratories and specialist classrooms since 1980.

chapters.headline: The Gathering Place
chapters.title: Ng Wah Hall
chapters.description: Completed in 1970, Ng Wah Hall has hosted generations of assemblies, performances, ceremonies, and community events at the heart of campus life.

chapters.headline: Performance and Community
chapters.title: Tang Shiu Kin Hall
chapters.description: A vibrant venue where performances, celebrations, and student life come together, reflecting the College's strong sense of community.

chapters.headline: A New Chapter
chapters.title: Benevolence House
chapters.description: Opened in 2022, Benevolence House bridges the historic campus with modern education through contemporary classrooms, theatre spaces, and student facilities.

chapters.headline: Beyond the Classroom
chapters.title: Leung Kau Kui Student Centre
chapters.description: Since 1988, the Student Centre has provided flexible spaces that encourage collaboration, leadership, and student development.

chapters.headline: Life on Campus
chapters.title: North House and College House
chapters.description: From North House's post-war restoration to the modern College House, these residences continue St. Stephen's century-long boarding tradition.

chapters.headline: Preserving the Past
chapters.title: Heritage Gallery
chapters.description: Restored historic bungalows preserve the stories of St. Stephen's College, the Battle of Hong Kong, and the Stanley Internment Camp for future generations.

chapters.headline: The Heart of Student Life
chapters.title: Central Square and Bell Plaza
chapters.description: Surrounded by historic architecture, these open spaces form the social heart of campus where students gather, celebrate, and connect every day.

chapters.headline: A Legacy of Sport
chapters.title: Tang Shiu Kin Sports Field
chapters.description: Originally reclaimed from marshland in the 1920s, the historic sports field has evolved into one of Hong Kong's most iconic school athletic venues overlooking the sea.

chapters.headline: One Campus. One Legacy.
chapters.title: St. Stephen's College
chapters.description: For over a century, St. Stephen's College has united heritage, innovation, and the beauty of Stanley Peninsula into one of Hong Kong's most remarkable educational campuses.
